notes.title: Zombiehood Is Part of Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/]Zombiehood[/url] we're officially part of Steam Next Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043517/2eae8b7a33a8de4810badc954732a754effbb539.png[/img]

To celebrate, we're launching our brand-new demo early — starting today! You can jump in right now, well ahead of Next Fest's official start on June 9th, and enjoy the experience throughout the event. The demo will remain available until June 30th, giving everyone plenty of time to dive in.

[h2]What’s New in the Demo?[/h2]
We’ve overhauled nearly every aspect of the game based on your feedback. Here are just a few of the major updates:

🎨 Visual Overhaul: New art for environments, interiors, items, and more

🧱 All-New Level Design: Every level rebuilt from scratch with improved depth and detail

🌗 Lighting & Atmosphere: Full day/night cycle, environmental lights, and a personal flashlight

🔊 Enhanced Audio: Positional sound for added immersion and spatial awareness

🔫 Updated Content: New and refined weapons, gear and artifacts — with improved visuals, effects, and balance

🧭 UI/UX Upgrades: Access key remapping and gamepad controls mid-run

⚙️ Refined Mechanics: Improved shooting and overall gameplay feel


While our Next Fest demo is live, we'll be collecting more player feedback via our [url=https://tally.so/r/nrrrWv]feedback form[/url], which can be accessed in-game, on [url=https://discord.gg/hDfm6hC]Discord[/url], and in our  [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3029290/discussions/1/]Steam forum[/url]. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please let us know!

Thanks for your support — and if the demo made you smile (or scream), drop us a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/]wishlist[/url]. It feeds the horde in our tiny outbreak.

notes.title: Announcing Zombiehood!!
notes.notes:
After all the positive reviews on Project Adder, I've been really encouraged to create a proper game out of this. After a few more months of work today I'm really excited to announce [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/Zombiehood/]Zombiehood[/url] on Steam!

If you've played Project Adder here's what to look forward to:
[list]
[*] Way more weapons, artifacts, equipment
[*] More levels
[*] Better enemy scaling and levels
[*] Better loot, xp, and reward scaling
[*] Control customization
[*] Proper ending, boss level, etc
[*] Metagame progression with money, skills
[*] Hopefully more
[/list]

Additionally, I've updated the Project Adder build to already reflect some of these changes.

I really want to thank everyone who left a review on the store page for Project Adder. It's difficult to develop in a silo with limited feedback and it means a lot to see actual players engaging with your game. I hope I can deliver a great experience with the full game in Zombiehood and beyond. If you're interested, please [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3003120/Zombiehood/] wishlist the game[/url], it really does help!

Thanks and happy Friday!
